name: DeBounce
summary: Single email validation with result, reason, role and free-provider flags and typo suggestions, optional name and avatar append, a free disposable-domain check, and credit and usage history.

api_key.description: A private DeBounce API key, 13 characters (app.debounce.io/api). Sent as the api query parameter.

notes: A private key allows 5 concurrent calls, or 2 when data enrichment (append) is on; past that the API answers 429.
Every reply carries success as "1" or "0"; on failure the debounce object holds an error message (401 wrong key, 402 credits low).
Values come back as strings ("true", "1", balance as a string), not booleans or numbers.
Bulk list upload and its status are not in this entry: only one bulk job runs per account and results come back as a CSV download link.

endpoints.name: Validate one email
endpoints.summary: Result (Safe to Send, Risky, Invalid, Unknown), reason, numeric code, role and free-email flags, send_transactional and a did_you_mean suggestion, with the remaining balance.

photo.description: Also return a profile photo when one is found; 1 extra credit per photo returned.

append.description: Also return the person's full name and avatar; 20 extra credits per successful enrichment.

notes: Uses validation credits; photo and append add their own charges only when they return data.
For signup forms DeBounce advises accepting deliverable, accept-all and unknown results, or any result with send_transactional = 1.
The numeric code maps to a detailed reason; the code table lives on DeBounce's help site.

endpoints.name: Check if an email or domain is disposable
endpoints.summary: Whether an address or domain belongs to a known disposable email service.

email.description: The email address or domain to check.

notes: Free and needs no key; daily and speed limits apply but are not published. Answers disposable as the string "true" or "false".

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: The validation credits left on the account.

endpoints.name: Get daily usage for a date range
endpoints.summary: Validations performed on each day between two dates.

start.description: Start date in YY-MM-DD (two-digit year), no earlier than 20-08-14.

end.description: End date in YY-MM-DD, no later than today.
